dialogues.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
dialogues.text: #How are we feeling today, Boss {NICKNAME}? Wanna show us how it's done?

choices.text: Let's start the Trial of Valor!

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: Your energy is incredible. I'm gonna have to watch this very, very closely!

choices.text: What kind of work do you do, my friend?

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: Haha, don't be so surprised. I mostly help out at Varesa's shop, hauling goods when we're out on business, and keeping an eye on the warehouse when we're back.

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: But Varesa did say, if the great hero ever needs it, the whole fruit stand and orchard are yours to call on!

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: So, in a way, I'm part of your support team too.

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: Back when I went to Fontaine on business, I really did send you my resume. Don't know if you remember that.

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: If you still remember, that alone would be an honor.

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: And if you don't... then next time you visit the Collective of Plenty, I'll treat you to a glass of Skysplit Gembloom Grainfruit juice — maybe then you'll remember me!

choices.text: I need to go take care of something else first.

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: I understand. I'll see you later then!
